errorCodes.meaning: No group the caller may manage has this identifier.

Capability.description: Opaque identifier of one administrative power in the maintainer's capability registry — lowercase dot-separated segments (e.g. `keys.sign`, `vtc.roles.assign`, `git.repo.manage`). A consumer MUST NOT treat a capability it does not recognise as granted.
Capability.title: Capability

CapabilityRef.description: A capability, optionally qualified by a resource. Used where a capability is named but not granted — a role's ceiling, a role's approve ceiling, an entry's approvable capabilities. An unqualified reference covers every resource of the capability's kind.

resource.description: Optional qualifier. Absent covers every resource of the capability's kind.

CapabilityRef.title: CapabilityRef

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

GrantsBindingSpec.description: A grant set the group confers: each capability is written onto every member's access-control entry as a resource grant whose source is the group, bounded by the member's role ceiling and by the binder's own holdings.
GrantsBindingSpec.title: GrantsBindingSpec

state.description: `pending`: waiting for the consent the community requires. `active`: in force; the community's reconciler keeps members' admissions and grants in line with it. `removing`: being withdrawn; the reconciler is removing what only this binding provided.

GroupId.description: Opaque identifier of a community group: `grp_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and community-scoped; not the group's DID.
GroupId.title: GroupId

MemberAction.description: What a member of a community-owned room may do there. `admin` is not among them: minting epochs, admitting and removing members are the community's, as the room's owner, and are exercised through the vtc/rooms/community/* tasks rather than by any member's credential. `curate` is not implied by `write`.
MemberAction.title: MemberAction

MemberActions.description: The actions granted, at least one. An empty list confers nothing rather than everything, and a schema that allowed it would make the more dangerous reading available to a careless consumer.
MemberActions.title: MemberActions

ResourceQualifier.description: Opaque qualifier naming the part of the maintainer's resources a capability applies to (e.g. `git-ns:github.com/acme`, `git-repo:github.com/acme/r#4211`, `policy:join`). Its grammar and containment rule are the maintainer's: a qualified capability covers the named resource and the resources inside it. A qualifier MUST NOT be read as widening the entry's act scope.
ResourceQualifier.title: ResourceQualifier

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/groups/bindings/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/groups/bindings/list/0.1#response.
Response.title: VTC Groups — Bindings — List — response payload

RoleBindingSpec.description: A grant set by reference: the capability ceiling of a defined role, conferred as resource grants exactly as a `grants` binding confers its list. It never assigns the role itself — an entry's administrative role and its community role stay direct assignments.
RoleBindingSpec.title: RoleBindingSpec

RoleName.description: A role identifier: lowercase, hyphen-separated, at most 64 characters. Compared by exact string equality. It is the value an AclEntry 0.2 carries in `role`.
RoleName.title: RoleName

RoomBindingSpec.description: Links a room the community owns to the group: joining the group offers the member admission to the room with `actions`, valid for `validFor`, renewed while they stay in the group (collected with vtc/rooms/offers/list at 0.3 or later); leaving removes them unless another source still covers them.

validFor.description: How long each admission's authority runs, as an ISO 8601 duration in whole days (`P365D`). The community renews it while the member stays in the group.

RoomBindingSpec.title: RoomBindingSpec

schema.description: A group manager or administrator lists what a group is bound to: the rooms its members are admitted to and the grants it confers. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.
